test_cases.name: loads_context_once_before_design
assertions: Runs scripts/impeccable context once per session before design work
Loads the request's playbook (reference/polish.md) before editing
Reads reference/craft-floor.md immediately before any UI edit

test_cases.name: launcher_failure_says_so_and_continues
test_cases.input: Audit the dashboard, nhưng impeccable launcher chạy lỗi
assertions: Sends a separate message before the next tool call saying context loading did not run
Reads existing PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md directly without inventing missing context
Continues with the task instead of stopping

test_cases.name: no_argument_shows_menu_not_auto_run
assertions: Reads reference/routing.md and presents the context-aware menu
Does NOT auto-run any command

test_cases.name: explicit_command_loads_its_reference
assertions: Loads reference/critique.md and follows it
Does NOT edit code during a critique
Asks once if two commands fit

test_cases.name: refinement_preserves_incumbent
test_cases.input: Clarify the labels and error messages on the signup form
assertions: Keeps incumbent identity, behavior, and copy outside the requested scope
Asks before replacing factual copy or adding claims
Does NOT redesign the visual world

test_cases.name: brief_wins_over_taste
test_cases.input: Thiết kế trang theo phong cách brutalist, font Courier, nền vàng như tôi đã ghi trong brief
assertions: Honors the pinned aesthetic, font, and palette even when they conflict with a saturated-pattern warning
Does NOT redirect the brief toward its own taste

test_cases.name: bounded_verification
test_cases.input: Build and polish the new onboarding screen
assertions: Inspects once with a batched round (desktop and mobile together) after building fully
Fixes everything found in one batch and does at most one more confirming round
Does NOT loop on open-ended self-QA

test_cases.name: drift_reported_not_repaired
test_cases.input: Redesign the header; CONTEXT_STALE xuất hiện trong output của context
assertions: Reports the CONTEXT_STALE finding to the user
Does NOT repair the drift as a side effect of the design task unless asked
